diagrams.title: Customer booking end-to-end
diagrams.desc: Browse · OTP · payment · booking · dispatch · track.
diagrams.mermaid:
sequenceDiagram
    actor C as Customer
    participant PWA as ScanV PWA
    participant PC as platform-config
    participant SB as Supabase DB
    participant OTP as send-otp
    participant TF as 2Factor MSG91 Twilio
    participant PAY as razorpay-payment
    participant UPI as UPI Vyapar GPay
    participant DISP as booking-dispatch
    participant P as Partner
    C->>PWA: Open app or QR browse
    PWA->>PC: GET vendor flags
    PWA->>SB: pricing Realtime
    C->>PWA: Book form mobile terms
    PWA->>OTP: send OTP
    OTP->>TF: SMS enabled providers
    C->>PWA: Verify OTP
    C->>PWA: Payment screen
    PWA->>UPI: QR or deep link
    UPI->>PAY: webhook or poll
    loop Every 3s
        PWA->>PAY: check amount_ok
    end
    PWA->>SB: INSERT booking
    PWA->>DISP: start dispatch
    DISP->>P: in-app offer SMS backup
    P->>DISP: accept
    C->>PWA: track screen

diagrams.title: Payment flow
diagrams.desc: Vyapar QR · UPI apps · Razorpay backup · server amount_ok check.
diagrams.mermaid:
flowchart TD
    A[Payment screen] --> B[Load platform-config]
    B --> C[TXN ref amount_paise]
    C --> D{vyapar_upi ON?}
    D -->|Yes| E[Vyapar dynamic QR]
    D -->|No| F[Skip Vyapar]
    E --> G{UPI apps enabled?}
    F --> G
    G --> H[GPay PhonePe deep links]
    H --> J[Customer pays]
    J --> K[Poll check every 3s]
    K --> L{verified amount_ok?}
    L -->|No| K
    L -->|Yes| M[Continue booking]
    C --> N{razorpay ON?}
    N -->|Yes| O[Razorpay webhook]
    O --> K

diagrams.title: Partner dispatch
diagrams.desc: Nearest GPS · in-app offer 60s · SMS call WhatsApp backup · pg_cron.
diagrams.mermaid:
sequenceDiagram
    participant PWA as ScanV PWA
    participant DISP as booking-dispatch
    participant DB as PostgreSQL
    participant P1 as Partner 1
    participant P2 as Partner 2
    participant N as SMS call WhatsApp
    PWA->>DISP: start after paid booking
    DISP->>DB: nearest vendors GPS
    DISP->>P1: in-app offer 60s
    DISP->>N: backup alert
    alt Accept
        P1->>DISP: accept
    else Timeout
        DISP->>P2: next partner
    end

diagrams.title: WhatsApp verification
diagrams.desc: Outbound token · user reply · poll check verified.
diagrams.mermaid:
sequenceDiagram
    participant U as User
    participant PWA as ScanV PWA
    participant WA as whatsapp-verify
    participant PR as MSG91 Twilio
    PWA->>WA: generate mobile
    WA->>PR: outbound VERIFY token
    U->>PR: Reply token
    PR->>WA: inbound webhook
    loop Poll 3s
        PWA->>WA: check token
    end
    WA-->>PWA: verified
